rationale:
No gap in the `{cite}` of `requirements.cli.setup_css` on `src/setup.rs#fn[is_configured]`.

- **Not a test.** `is_configured` only reports whether a project is already set up. It does not verify setup behavior.
- **Not an `{impl}` root.** `requirements.cli.setup_css` requires `habeas setup` to keep existing `output.html.additional-css` entries, add the Habeas stylesheet at most once, and report an error when `additional-css` is not an array. `is_configured` does none of these. It makes no decision about preserving entries, avoiding duplicates, or reporting an error. It only reads `additional-css` and returns false if the array is missing or lacks the Habeas CSS entry.
- **`{cite}` fits.** The function recognizes the form that setup produces, an `additional-css` array containing the stylesheet path from `css_relative`. It uses that to decide whether setup is still needed. A change to how the requirement says the stylesheet is added could require changing this check, so it relies on the requirement.
- **Not redundant.** The item has no `{impl}` or `{test}` reference to `requirements.cli.setup_css`. Its `{impl}` references are to `requirements.cli.setup_project` and `requirements.integration.symposium_setup_hook`.

text: `habeas setup` MUST preserve existing entries in `output.html.additional-css` while adding the Habeas stylesheet at most once. It MUST report an error if `additional-css` is not an array.
